name: Superlist
soft_passes: #4 16px squint: curl reads as a light diagonal swoosh, the S letterform does not crisply resolve; saturated red is the stronger ID anchor at menu-bar size
#7 figure-ground: survives grayscale via shadow modeling but glyph and background are one material, so no classic hue/shape contrast
#10 variant robustness: era-appropriate N/A, but a mono/tinted render would flatten the tonal relief and lose the letterform
failures: #3 silhouette: filled solid black the icon is a featureless squircle — the S is carried entirely by tonal relief, not shape, so the subject is not nameable from silhouette alone
light_model: Top-down, slight top-left soft key; short soft self-shadows pooling in the folds; faint highlight rim on lifted paper edges; matte, no specular gloss
layer_stack: baked squircle drop-shadow (web-render artifact, below tile)
devices: monochrome sculptural relief (figure and ground are one material)
folded-paper logomark (the S as a curled list page)
full-bleed field with no background/glyph split
tonal-only figure-ground carried entirely by baked self-shadow
rhymes_hint: monochrome sculptural brand-mark family — single-hue matte logomarks modeled by baked self-shadow rather than a background+glyph split; opposite pole from the classic Big Sur field-plus-diagonal-tool tradition; consumer-productivity marks that lead with one saturated identity color as the Dock anchor
notes: 513x512 AVIF->PNG web render; mask and drop-shadow pre-baked, corners transparent, so edge crispness and micro-shadow softness are partly resize/compression artifacts (true 1024 source likely cleaner). Monochrome-relief means silhouette test hard-fails and a mono/tinted appearance variant would lose the S entirely - the mark depends on the red gradient rendering. Icon is a full-bleed logomark, not the Big Sur field+centered-glyph composition (a signature deviation). Brand-context: the Superlist app UI is dark purple/indigo (per cover) so the warm-red icon is identity/Dock-anchor duty, not subject depiction - 'tasks/notes/plans' is not illustrated, only the brand S. Cover render agrees with standalone icon (pure monochrome red, no secondary tone).
